verdict.rationale: Migration from QuickBooks has a help-center article ([digits-docs-19]), but the pack shows only its title, with no detail on what history is brought over or how. The Connect API's batch transaction sync with external_id deduplication ([digits-supp-api-reference]) could serve as an import path, but it is documented for ongoing syncing rather than historical migration. Missing for 10: documented migration procedure and scope, evidence that line-level transaction detail (memos, classes, attachments, splits) is preserved, support for accounting systems other than QuickBooks, and independent or hands-on migration reports.
